scope: Read-only review of the completed M50 v4 live run and its four launch evidence artifacts. No provider, secret, evaluator-key, retry, source, candidate, runtime, account, publication, deployment, release, or commit action was performed.

terminal_closure.cost_all_native_costs_final_explanation: The field is defined as success-and-exact; this failed run nevertheless has one exact native settlement and no pending or uncertain attempt.

wrapper_error.source_supported_cause: .superpowers/openrouter-50-v4/backend-cli.ts writes completion JSON only in rehearse mode; its live path stops and returns without stdout. .superpowers/openrouter-50-v4-src/wrapper.ts then unconditionally parses the final backend stdout line as JSON. After the controlled live shutdown this empty-output parse is the narrow deterministic secondary wrapper failure.

grader_boundary.basis: .superpowers/openrouter-50-v4/grade-terminal.ts verifies the success terminal body, payload, cost, and shutdown files before constructing or reading the evaluator-key path. The live workspace lacks the required success terminal file, and the probe refused with a deliberately nonexistent evaluator root.

established: The request crossed the provider boundary once and its exact request was captured before dispatch.
A provider HTTP-200 body was decoded far enough to yield a valid native response cost, which was durably settled.
The analyze stage then emitted failed and the application returned provider_failure with no plan or verify stage.
root_cause.not_established: The precise subcategory cannot be recovered. The frozen runtime persisted only stage, attempt, phase, and timestamp; it discarded the safe code, failure_phase, failure_detail, router_identity_field, router_pipeline_failure, stop_reason, and usage fields supplied by the provider layer. Preserved evidence therefore cannot distinguish router identity, pipeline, stop reason, content shape, inner JSON, or the stage-completion callback without speculation.
root_cause.terminal_reason_observability_note: The outer research endpoint returned HTTP 200 with status unavailable/provider_failure. runtime.ts called success finalization based on HTTP status, then changed the terminal reason to terminal_preconditions_failed because fewer than three settled stages existed. The hash closure is valid, but this reason masks the earlier safe provider_failure category.

findings.title: The live provider failure subtype is not preserved and the terminal reason masks the application provider failure
findings.impact: The paid request is safely stopped and exactly costed, but engineering cannot determine the response-contract failure subtype from the immutable evidence. A retry would be diagnosis by spending and is not authorized.
findings.required_repair: Persist the already-sanitized stage failure code, failure_phase, failure_detail, bounded router identity/pipeline label, stop_reason, and safe numeric usage in the exclusive stage record. When the research endpoint returns status unavailable/provider_failure in an HTTP-200 envelope, bind that safe reason into terminal closure instead of replacing it with terminal_preconditions_failed. Rehearse each label offline before freezing new bytes.

findings.title: The wrapper unconditionally parses a completion record that the live backend never emits
findings.impact: A correctly stopped live failure is followed by a misleading wrapper_refused record, conflating the model/provider outcome with a local orchestration defect.
findings.required_repair: Define and emit a small secret-free terminal completion JSON record from the live backend after controlled shutdown, or make the wrapper validate the preserved terminal/shutdown hashes directly. Require the wrapper to distinguish backend nonzero exit, missing completion record, and terminal failure without generating another provider request.

conclusion: FAIL as a live answer execution, with PASS for one-use admission, exact native cost settlement, durable failure closure, grader refusal, and controlled cleanup. The run spent one authorized analyze request and stopped. Preserved evidence narrows the primary failure to post-response analyze handling but cannot recover its exact safe subtype. A separate deterministic live-backend/stdout mismatch produced the later wrapper_refused label. No retry is authorized or supported by this review.
